purpose: Ask only the owner questions that discovery and safe defaults cannot answer without changing the first route.

discovery_permission.prompt: May Bootstrap perform safe read-only discovery of this project so it can answer technical setup questions for you?
disclosure: Discovery reads source, configuration shape, documentation, and available tool metadata only.
Discovery does not modify files, request secrets, authenticate, spend money, publish, deploy, or delete.
Detected facts are labelled and never become owner intent without confirmation.

selection_law.order: Ask the earliest unresolved owner-intent or owner-boundary question that can materially change outcome, authority, route, proof, rollback, or unavailable behavior.
selection_law.discovery: Resolve mechanical facts from secret-free discovery and show candidate interpretations only when they need confirmation.
selection_law.defaults: Use safe configuration defaults when they do not change the first route; record the choice and allow later revision.
selection_law.sufficiency: Stop after the smallest set of answers that makes the first bounded route honest and reversible; defer non-route-changing preferences.

questions.prompt: Which repositories, documents, data sources, environments, and external systems belong inside the project boundary?
Who is this for, what recurring moment matters, and what should be better after the project works?
What is the first user workflow that should prove the project is useful, and what does working mean?
Which safety, legal, privacy, data-loss, spending, authentication, irreversible-action, or intent boundaries must remain owner-controlled?
Should Bootstrap import, align, or create the authority corpus, and is there an existing source to preserve?
Discovery found the current stack and delivery shape. Are any material technologies, providers, deployment targets, or authentication routes required or forbidden?
What design context and user conditions matter—such as device, field, offline, accessibility, or protected visual surfaces—and what should the Design Bible optimize for?
Which operating economics describe this project: continuous eco, a standard workweek, performance-first, or custom conditions?

owner_question_budget.rule: Conditional questions do not appear when exact discovery resolves them or the surface is not applicable.

ECO_CONTINUOUS.objective: minimize expected cost per accepted result while meeting the completion floor

STANDARD_WORKWEEK.objective: minimize expected cost per accepted result within a normal workweek

PERFORMANCE.objective: minimize elapsed time after meeting the completion floor

CUSTOM.objective: use only the explicitly supplied typed constraints

legacy_preservation.source_order: inspect -> archive -> manifest/index/receipt verification -> build or write the new authority corpus
legacy_preservation.unsafe_objects: reject symbolic links, sockets, devices, and other non-regular filesystem entries
legacy_preservation.exclusions: record every excluded path and reason; do not silently discard unfamiliar files
